title: Height-Balanced Sexp Matrix: Invariant-Preserving Indexing in Aether-Flux
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We introduce a height-balanced matrix of S-expressions (SexpMatrix) implemented in Aether-Flux, designed to support efficient random access, mutation, and transposition while preserving strict structural invariants. The matrix stores nested S-expressions in a contiguous two-dimensional vector, enabling spatially localized traversal without explicit alignment directives. We formally prove that the data structure maintains a height-balance invariant, guaranteeing $O(\log n)$ amortized access and update costs, and we empirically evaluate its performance on an AMD EPYC 9V45 platform. Across 30 benchmark iterations, the mean latency per operation is 662.43 \textmu{}s ($\pm$20.03 \textmu{}s), with a throughput of 1,509,585 ops/s. These results confirm that the SexpMatrix achieves both theoretical efficiency and practical scalability for symbolic computation workloads. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Aether-Flux-algorithms/tree/main/algorithms/20261119_010216_sexp_matrix}.
